# Website

> Embed a production-ready workflow editor into your React app. NPM SDK + reference back-end on GitHub. Free Community, EUR 6,990 Enterprise.

- [Workflow Builder - React SDK for Embedding Workflow Editors](/index.html.md): Embed a production-ready workflow editor into your React app. NPM SDK + reference back-end on GitHub. Free Community, EUR 6,990 Enterprise.
- [Visual Workflow Builder for Code-First AI Agents (React SDK)](/ai-agent-workflows.html.md): Embed a visual workflow builder for code-first AI agents. React SDK + Apache 2.0 reference back-end + swappable execution (Temporal, Inngest). Free Community Edition.
- [Workflow Builder Blog — React Workflow Editor Guides](/blog.html.md): Expert guides on building workflow editors in React: React Flow tutorials, SDK integration, AI workflow design, and best practices for embedding workflows in SaaS products.
- [Build vs Buy a Workflow Editor — the real cost of React Flow](/build-vs-buy.html.md): Building a workflow editor on React Flow takes 14–25 weeks ($67k–$120k). Workflow Builder SDK ships in 1–4 weeks. Compare costs, see case studies.
- [Workflow Builder Consulting – Implementation, Integration](/consulting.html.md): The Workflow Builder team integrates the React SDK end-to-end - custom nodes, back-end integration, vertical-specific delivery. 15 years of engineering.
- [Contact Workflow Builder — Demo or Enterprise License](/contact.html.md): Get in touch with the Workflow Builder team. Request a live demo, ask about Enterprise licensing and pricing, or discuss implementation consulting for your product.
- [Workflow Builder FAQ - Pricing, License, Integration, AI](/faq.html.md): 20+ answers about Workflow Builder Community vs Enterprise, Apache 2.0, Temporal integration, AI workflows, and embedding into React.
- [Workflow Builder React SDK - npm install for developers](/for-developers.html.md): Build a production workflow editor without rebuilding the canvas. NPM React SDK + reference back-end on GitHub + TypeScript code examples. Apache 2.0.
- [Workflow Builder Open Source - Apache 2.0 on GitHub](/open-source.html.md): Apache 2.0 React SDK + reference back-end + Temporal adapter. Commercial use OK, no copyleft, no relicensing. Hard commit - no BSL or SSPL.
- [Workflow Builder Pricing - Free, EUR 6,990 Enterprise](/pricing.html.md): Open-source Community Edition (Apache 2.0) or Enterprise license with Flow Runner, the design system in Figma, advanced canvas plugins. Two paths - DIY or partner-led.
- [Perks for React Summit NYC attendees](/reactsummit.html.md): Join our workshop at React Summit 2025 and get exclusive UI tools, webbooks, and dev perks. Build better diagram UIs with Workflow Builder.
- [Workflow Builder Reference Stack — Open Source, Apache 2.0](/reference-stack.html.md): Open source workflow orchestration reference architecture. Three apps, three port interfaces, Apache 2.0. Swap the engine without rewriting the editor.

- [Flowise Alternative: Embeddable Workflow Editor SDK](/compare/flowise.html.md): Compare Workflow Builder vs Flowise. React SDK for canvas embed, no LangChain.js lock-in, no chat-widget cap. Built for AI product teams.
- [Langflow Alternative: Embeddable Workflow Editor SDK](/compare/langflow.html.md): Compare Workflow Builder vs Langflow. TypeScript React SDK for canvas embed, no LangChain Python lock-in, no IBM watsonx coupling.
